reason: The hypothesis proposes a specific, testable mechanism—locally accelerated grain-boundary diffusion of Ti leading to TiO2 islands that disrupt protective scale formation—that is not stated or directly suggested in any single passage. It integrates the general concept of grain-boundary diffusion (P5, P13) with the known oxidation behavior of Ti (P11) and the role of Cr/Al scales (P8), but applies this combination to a new alloy (Al0.2Co1.5CrFeNi1.5Ti0.3) and contrasts oxidizing vs. reducing atmospheres, which none of the passages do. The falsification test is also tailored to this specific mechanism.
